newsitem.title: USA: Schumacher nominated as USDA undersecretary.
newsitem.headline: Schumacher nominated as USDA undersecretary.

text.p: The Clinton Administration Thursday nominated August Schumacher as Undersecretary for Farm and Foreign Agricultural Services at the U.S. Agriculture Department.
The nomination had been widely expected.
The undersecretary oversees USDA's Farm Service Agency, Foreign Agricultural Service and Risk Management Agency.
These three agencies manage the department's farm and foreign programs, ranging from farm operating and emergency loans to crop insurance to export financing and trade policy.
Schumacher currently works as adminstrator of USDA's Foreign Agricultural Service. Prior, he was the Massachusetts state commissioner for food and agriculture from 1985-1990.

He also worked for the World Bank's agricultural lending group on projects in Central Europe, the former Soviet Union, China, Mexico, the Middle East, and Africa, the White House said in a statement announcing the nomination.
